{{Top|leg}}
The '''perception sensors''' were a cluster of sensors integrated into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that scanned the entire light spectrum and audio frequencies. This allowed the droid to be aware of activity and hazardous conditions within its perceptive range.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
